property_summary: The hash state variable must equal the last _hash argument passed to setL1BlockValues; the mutant breaks this because it stores keccak256(abi.encodePacked(_hash)) instead of the raw _hash.
change_summary: Replace 'hash = _hash;' with 'hash = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(_hash));' so that a hashed version of the argument is stored.
